_note: Curated NAMED ENTITIES for the narrative_detail support tier (research/dossier.py). A sentence that names one of these is about a PERSON, a GROUP or an EVENT, not about materials — so it becomes support material for the writer instead of falling into spec. Amend this file the way you amend moments.json: it is data, and the classifier has no entity knowledge of its own.
_never_a_hook: narrative_detail is NOT in HOOKABLE_TAGS and never will be. Adding a name here can only ever affect what SUPPORTS a lead, never what opens one. Adding a wrong name costs a dull support fact; it cannot promote filler into a hook.
_matching: CASE-SENSITIVE, whole-phrase, word-bounded. Case-sensitive because the colour 'off-white' and the label 'Off-White' are the same letters — case is the only thing that separates a materials sentence ('off-white leather overlays') from a collaborator ('Off-White™ for NIKE'). Matching these case-insensitively put 11 pure materials sentences into the narrative tier. Proper nouns are capitalised in GOAT prose, so nothing is lost.
_placement_exception: Naming an entity is NOT enough on its own. If the only mention sits in a branding-placement frame ('a Cactus Jack patch adorns the tongue'), the sentence stays spec — see placement_frames in narrative_markers.json. 54 sentences are held back that way.
_seeded: 2026-09-12 — derived from the 735 spec facts across 250 dossiers. Names present in that corpus, plus collaborators likely to appear next.
_collectives_note: OUTSIDE parties only. 'Nike SB' and 'Jordan Brand' are deliberately absent: they are the house, they appear on half the catalog, and they corroborate nothing — the same reasoning that keeps 'nike' and 'jordan' in GENERIC_TOKENS.
